title: Characteristics and Prognosis of Moderate or Severe Tricuspid Regurgitation
official: Clinical and Echocardiographic Characteristics and Prognosis of trIcuspid regurgiTation (EPIT): Prospective and Retrospective Follow-up of a Cohort of Patients With Moderate or Severe Tricuspid Regurgitation
summary: The tricuspid valve : its evaluation is relatively difficult in echocardiography and the management of tricuspid valve diseases remains poorly codified.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>18 ans
* inclusion criteria: moderate or severe tricuspid regurgitation
* exclusion criteria: Refusal to participate/ prior surgery of the tricuspid valve
